push.push_msg_test_body: If you can read this, CodeIsland can reach you here.
push.push_desc: Send approvals, questions, finished turns and errors to your phone (Bark, ntfy, Telegram) or a team chat (DingTalk, Feishu / Lark, WeCom, Slack). Unlike the webhook above, each service gets the format it expects, signed where the service supports it.
push.push_only_when_away_desc: Push only while the screen is locked, the screen saver is running, the display is asleep, or there's been no keyboard or mouse input for the time below.
push.push_event_reminder_help: Needs Follow-up reminders (above) turned on. Approvals and questions still waiting are sent again; a finished turn nobody looked at gets one reminder, unless its own push already went out.
push.push_include_details_desc: Commands, replies, error text and answer options. Off: only the agent, project, what happened and the tool or question label — for chats other people read.
push.push_hint_bark: Paste the key from the Bark app, or the whole https://api.day.app/<key> URL into Server. A self-hosted bark-server works too; for basic auth use https://user:password@host. Approvals and questions arrive as Time Sensitive.
push.push_hint_ntfy: ntfy.sh or your own server. Paste https://ntfy.sh/<topic> into Server or fill in Topic; the token is sent as Authorization: Bearer.
push.push_hint_dingtalk: Custom robot webhook (oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=…). With the 加签 security setting, paste the SEC… secret; with custom keywords, add the keyword CodeIsland. DingTalk allows 20 messages a minute per robot.
push.push_hint_feishu: Custom bot webhook (open.feishu.cn or open.larksuite.com/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/…). With signature verification on, paste its secret; with custom keywords, add the keyword CodeIsland.
push.push_hint_wecom: Group robot webhook (qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=…). WeCom allows 20 messages a minute.
push.push_hint_telegram: Token from @BotFather and the chat_id to deliver to. Send your bot a message first — bots can't start a chat. API server is only needed for a self-hosted Bot API server.
push.push_storage_note: Tokens and secrets are kept in CodeIsland's preferences on this PC and only sent to the service they belong to. Plain http:// works only for addresses on your local network.

hooks.autoApproveToolsHint: These internal tools are auto-approved without showing a confirmation dialog. Disable tools you want to review manually.
hooks.autoApproveSourcesHint: Comma-separated agent ids. Permission requests from these agents are approved without a card — for CLIs already running in their own Turbo / YOLO / always-proceed mode. Questions are still asked.
hooks.claudeConfigHint: Where Claude Code keeps projects/ and settings.json. Leave empty to auto-detect ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, then whichever of ~/.claude or ~/.config/claude-code actually holds your projects, preferring ~/.claude). Set this if you use a custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR — a Finder-launched app does not inherit your shell environment. Restart CodeIsland after changing.
hooks.excludedPathsHint: Comma-separated substrings. Any hook event whose working directory contains one of them is silently dropped — useful for filtering out background plugins like claude-mem. Example: .claude-mem,.cache/agents
hooks.webhookHint: Forward hook events to an external HTTP endpoint as JSON. Useful for piping agent activity into DingTalk / Lark / Slack via a generic webhook receiver. Failures are silently ignored.
hooks.webhookFilterHint: Comma-separated event names; empty = forward every event. Names can be normalized (PreToolUse) or raw (pre_tool_use).
